description: Bounded deterministic offline moment calibration: starting p=old per-kill mean/value, hard floor value/count conditioning, damped log-odds marginal matching. No production edits.
selection: Stop when every role/rank expected credit is within 6.5% of old, or acceptance falls below 5.5%; prefer bounded efficient rejection over overfitting exact means.
selectedStatus: accepted-denomination-v1: 1–2 offline calibration steps; shipped and verified on 900000 plans
